role: The image relocated between rows: each recording of a relocate set (out/java/relocate/NAME/manifest.json: recs, every) replays twice in image environments on one round-robin baton; before every EVERY-th row the first run's image is copied to another slot (image_relocate against its twin at the same row) and its old mapping unmapped. Every run must replay exact; prints moves, bytes copied, words rebased per move by part, and words naming run memory outside the image. no-rebase is the negative check (the copy alone must fail).
